title: Villagers Reimagined
description: Improve Mojang's way to rebalance villager.
body:
# Mod is dead simple:

- Swamp: only type of villager that can have librabrian and cleric job, unemployed swamp villager can also harvest nearby nether wart and replant them, use 1 emerald to take some of their warts out (they also deposit into a chest if passively walked to it, though this is currently kinda buggy).
- Jungle: can have fletcher job, harvesting crop has a 50% chance to +3 the items.
- Plains: can have butcher, shepherd, leatherworker job.
- Taiga: can have armorer and toolsmith job.
- Desert: can have catographer and mason job.
- Tundra: can have armorer, toolsmith, butcher and leatherworker, all emerald trade is reduced by 2.
- Savana: can have butcher, shepherd, leatherworker job.
-------
- All the other jobs that are not mentioned can be taken globally by every villager type.
